items.question: Owner must revoke/rotate affected provider credentials and supply redacted containment evidence.
Which exact material/GSM/claim per SKU has supplier/batch evidence, validity and rights to publish?
items.recommendation: No material/certification/performance claim approval until verified.

items.question: Confirm exact return/size-exchange scope, cost, limit and period. Lifetime/at-home legacy promises cannot be assumed.
items.recommendation: Quarantine affected service promises; do not edit protected catalog.

items.question: Confirm active offers, price source, coupon/ship scope and effective dates.
Confirm SKU-specific size/preorder/lead time and approved live inventory source. Stillwater source is M/L despite general S/M description.
items.recommendation: No scarcity claim or live availability inferred from initial stock.

items.question: Provide order-linked testimonial provenance and permission, asset/model/music licensing and revocation handling.
items.recommendation: No publication approval from verified=true or legacy approved flags.

items.question: Assign commerce owner to review payment source/auth, read-only export, server-bound UTM and reconciled financial events.
items.recommendation: Cash/organic profit UNKNOWN; Capital Gate FAIL.

items.question: Confirm legal review, consent purposes, retention and processors before CRM or customer audience work.
items.recommendation: No marketing sends or customer data exports.

items.question: Owner to approve reserve, cost data, thresholds, signer identities and exact paid scope after organic evidence exists.
items.recommendation: Leave thresholds null, budget 0 and Ads disabled.
